intro: Critical infrastructure and government entities were the primary targets in a series of high-severity incidents tracked under the FBI tag between April 13 and April 30, 2026. Threat actors Handala Hack, Interlock, and LummaC2 were observed in campaigns affecting the United States, Iran, and other regions across North America and globally. The five reported intrusions also impacted the healthcare and logistics sectors, underscoring a broad operational focus.
